author: feral-core
description: Read local PDF files: layout-preserving text, markdown tables, embedded images as base64, and document metadata. Needs PyMuPDF, which ships as a dependency. OCR of scanned pages is NOT included: it needs pytesseract and a tesseract binary, neither of which FERAL installs, and without them a page with no embedded text layer comes back as the literal string '[OCR not available - install pytesseract]' rather than as text. Say that plainly instead of guessing at the page contents.

endpoints.description: Extract rich text from a local PDF with layout-preserving structure, markdown tables and optional images. A page with an embedded text layer always works. A scanned page falls through to OCR, which is only available when pytesseract and tesseract are installed; otherwise that page returns '[OCR not available - install pytesseract]'.

params.name: path
params.description: Absolute or relative path to a PDF file on this machine. Read directly from disk with no workspace-grant check, so any path this process can read works, and a path that does not exist comes back as 404 rather than as a permission error.

params.name: page_end
params.description: 1-based page number to end at (default: last page)

params.name: max_chars
params.description: Maximum number of characters to return (default 60000)

params.name: include_images
params.description: Whether to extract embedded images as base64 (default false)

endpoints.returns_description: Structured text with page metadata, markdown tables, optional images, and truncation flag

endpoints.description: Read PDF metadata: title, author, creation date, page count, keywords. Needs no OCR.

params.name: path
params.description: Absolute or relative path to a PDF file on this machine. Read directly from disk with no workspace-grant check, so any path this process can read works, and a path that does not exist comes back as 404 rather than as a permission error.

endpoints.returns_description: PDF metadata fields (title, author, subject, dates, page count)

endpoints.description: Extract embedded images from PDF pages as base64-encoded PNGs.

params.name: path
params.description: Absolute or relative path to a PDF file on this machine. Read directly from disk with no workspace-grant check, so any path this process can read works, and a path that does not exist comes back as 404 rather than as a permission error.

params.name: page_end
params.description: 1-based page number to end at (default: last page)

params.name: max_images
params.description: Maximum number of images to extract (default 10, max 50)

endpoints.returns_description: Array of base64-encoded PNG images with dimensions and page numbers
